ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the RT-4 (Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 14-H in the area bounded by

A LINE [50 FEET NORTH OF AND PARALLEL TO WEST 56TH STREET; THE PUBLIC
ALLEY NEXT EAST OF AND PARALLEL TO SOUTH OAKLEY AVENUE; A LINE 50
FEET NORTH OF AND PARALLEL TO WEST 56TH STREET: AND SOUTH OAKLEY
AVENUE:

to those of a C2-! (Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District).

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 5531-5537 S Oakley Ave Chicago, IL 60636
